title: Worth every penny. Simply amazing!
text:
I always wanted to see a  Flamenco show and even though the show was less than an hour, it was well worth it.
I loved seeing the passion that the dancers and singers displayed. The highlight was the male Flamenco dancers amazing speed and control of his heels. It was a stunning display of energy.
author: Edward_A

title: Highly recommend when in Barcelona
text: Exceptional experience!!  Arrive early to relax and prepare for the show.  Our taxi driver dropped us off at the wrong location making us late.
author: Terri_T

title: This was a highly...
text: This was a highly energetic experience.  I was amazed at the energy the dancers had along with the experience of their performances. I would definitely recommend this as something to do in Barcelona.
author: Debora_G

title: Nice show
text: Good show! It is simple and gives a good show of Flamenco. Nice costumes and ok drinks. Seats are just padded chairs, a little small.

title: Intensely Great Show
text: Exciting, Emotional and Intense entertainment. Like walking into a speakeasy and getting blasted with the most exhilarating song & dance 💃 🎶

title: Amazing Flamenco
text: This show never ceases to amaze me, I will never tire of seeing it every time I come to Barcelona, I will always come

title: You should go
text: We really enjoyed this show. It's a smaller theater so it feels intimate which was really nice.  The dancers were very talented and the guitar players are quite impressive. Very passionate performances. Well worth it
